title: Root Tears

positions.as_written: Follow the root on consecutive sagittal images, since the posterior medial root is the commonest site and is small.
Measure extrusion on the coronal image, because extrusion is the consequence and is often more conspicuous than the tear.
Repair restores the anchor and does not reliably reverse extrusion, so the mechanical correction is partial and the imaging after repair reflects that.
